skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS write deliverables to the task directory (`tasks/<id>/`), NOT to `/root/` on the host filesystem. The host verifier only stages files from the task directory to `<stage>/root/`.
ALWAYS read `tests/test_outputs.py` before writing output — it defines the exact schema, field names, tolerance (e.g., `rel_tol=0.001`), and file paths the verifier checks.
skillsbench-host-grading.description: How SkillsBench host verification works — where deliverables must live, what the verifier checks, and common pitfalls.
